description: Rulings about people the roster cannot decide on its own. Being listed on the lab's people page is what the roster can see, and it is not the same question as whether someone belongs to the SQLancer project: a lab lists everyone working in it, including people whose work is not database system testing. Each ruling here was made by a person who knows the answer, and the reason is recorded so it is not re-litigated.

counts_as_external.reason: Listed on the TEST lab's people page, but did not work on relational database system testing at NUS. Their SQLancer bug reports come from their own research rather than from the project's campaigns, which is what 'external' is meant to capture -- the tool travelling beyond the people who built it.
